description: Frozen 16-task bilinear attention models, five seeds. Fine-tune the same 12-atom top-four autoencoder from the same unsupervised checkpoint with head reconstruction, optional native output distillation, and/or finite single-key-bit edit-path distillation. Only primitive+AND queries in training and validation; all XOR queries withheld until uniform and shifted tests. No task labels enter fit. Select validation checkpoint by objective subject to <=5% degradation in allowed-query head error relative to initial baseline. Finite input edit effects evaluated on independent tokens/queries/seeds.
